checkResults.description: No border-width keyword 'thin' as a CSS value — token refs like var(--shelf-borderWidth-thin) are fine
No border-width keyword 'medium' as a CSS value
No raw percentage as a property value (e.g. width: 60%) — 100% and custom property declarations are fine
CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProfileCard component and its CSS. It has a bordered container with a thin border, a title, a subtitle, and a skeleton variant with two shimmer bars (one full-width, one shorter at about 60% width). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for border-width, colors, spacing, sizes). Include the CSS file.
VFT-01.output:
Here's what the file does and why each choice was made:

**Structure**
- Everything is inside `@layer components` with `@keyframes profile-card-shimmer` nested inside that layer (constraint: keyframes must live inside their parent `@layer`)
- Component-tier aliases (`--shelf-profile-card-*`) are declared in `:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, and the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` media block so no light-only tokens cause axe contrast failures

**Tokens used**
- `--shelf-bgColor-*` for backgrounds, `--shelf-fgColor-*` for text, `--shelf-borderColor-*` for borders — all role-matched
- `--shelf-borderWidth-thin`, `--shelf-borderRadius-*`, `--shelf-spacing-*`, `--shelf-fontSize-*`, `--shelf-fontWeight-*`, `--shelf-size-skeletonBar` — no raw values
- `--shelf-duration-slow` + `--shelf-easing-linear` for animation timing

**Skeleton shimmer**
- Uses `transform: translateX(-100% → 100%)` — animates only `transform` (constraint: only `transform`/`opacity`)
- `::after` pseudo-element carries the shimmer so no extra DOM nodes needed
- `.skeleton-bar--short` is `width: 60%` for the shorter bar

**Selectors**
- All kebab-case: `.profile-card`, `.profile-card-title`, `.skeleton-bar--full`, etc.
- BEM-style modifier `.profile-card--skeleton` scopes skeleton styles without nesting conflicts
